title: Delivery receipt
description: Body of POST /v1/receipts from the phone (plan 15.3, 16.2). receipt_id is the idempotency key: the same receipt_id with the same body is acknowledged again without changing state, the same receipt_id with a different body is a 409 conflict. 'Queued on Mac' is the Mac's own state and is never sent as a receipt; the phone reports downloaded_to_phone (all bytes verified on the phone), imported_into_sylvia (the library item committed) or import_failed (with a failure; the Mac keeps the entry for retry). A receipt never deletes the original source file.

queue_entry_id.description: The device-inbox entry this receipt is for, or null for an item fetched from the catalog without a queue entry.

failure.description: Required for import_failed; absent otherwise. The message is shown on the Mac and must not contain titles, paths, notes or selected text.
